description.value: Legacy Liquor Store is Vancouver's largest privately-owned liquor store, founded in 2010 in the Olympic Village neighbourhood just off the southeast shore of False Creek near Science World. The store carries over 5,000 unique items — including hundreds of exclusives — spanning wine, spirits, beer, cider, sake, and non-alcoholic options from more than 70 countries, with staff that includes sommeliers, cicerones, and spirits specialists. A touring cyclist rolling through the False Creek Greenway corridor will find an exceptionally well-curated stop for BC craft beer, local spirits, and hard-to-find international selections, with online ordering and in-store pickup also available.
